findings: Stage 7 sensitivity uses raw proxy residuals, not the Stage 4 baseline (disclosed); rerun on the Stage 4 baseline before any scoring phase.
Individual pressure residual uncertainty is very wide (median 95% CI width about 74 for batters; Top 10 bootstrap overlap 5.2-7.0); no individual ordering is supportable, keep non-publishable.
Quantile thresholds and LOMO par are FULL_SAMPLE/descriptive; a temporal split is needed before any predictive or validated claim.
Two deliverable tests use pytest.skip when outputs are absent; prefer a hard failure or fixture in CI.
